content:
Maria: Heads up — deploybot auto-pinned runtime v3.2 -> v3.1 for model-group:quant-pipelines after 5 failures on quant-v4b in prod. Details from deploybot below.

deploybot: [AUTO] Pin applied: runtime=3.2 -> pinned_to=3.1; reason=KV cache OOMs; affected=quant-pipelines; ticket=ENGINF-2473

Asher: Can we get the rollout window? When did it happen?

Maria: ~10:12 UTC. Canary traffic triggered. I pulled logs — OOM spike correlated with longseq requests + quant activation. Not seeing same in staging.

Priya: Any quick mitigations? Could we route those model IDs to dedicated pool `dedicated-quant-1` for now?

Jamal: +1 for routing. But `dedicated-quant-1` is near capacity. We can throttle batch size for that group: set `max_batch_tokens=1024`.

Maria: Agree. Priya, Jamal — can you coordinate a temporary routing rule and update deploybot pinlist exemption for model-group:quant-pipelines? We need an escape hatch so customers aren't dropped.

Priya: I'll open a PR to routing rules and add an exemption entry. ETA ~30m. Will ping #eng-oncall.

Asher: Also: note SDK 2.8.1 has a change affecting KV cache serialization in quant runtime. Could be contributing. @Taylor can confirm.

Taylor: Confirmed. There's a regression in SDK 2.8.1 when used with runtime 3.2 + quant backend. Patch incoming for SDK 2.8.2. Recommend pinning SDK to 2.8.0 for affected services.

Maria: OK — plan: 1) Add deploybot exemption for model-group:quant-pipelines (temporary) 2) Route quant-pipelines to dedicated pool + throttle batch size 3) Pin SDK to 2.8.0 for those services 4) Monitor for 2 hours then reassess. If no regressions, we'll unpin runtime. Rollback plan: re-pin to 3.2 only if SDK 2.8.2 patch validated.

Jamal: I'll implement routing + throttles now and post the PR link.

Priya: PR 7834 opened: https://git.internal/routing/PR/7834 — includes deploybot exemption update. Please review.

Asher: Thx. One more ask — can we add a deploybot alert rule to avoid auto-pin if failure rate is confined to quant models? We want more specific gating.

Maria: Good idea. Filing ENGINF-2478 to capture deploybot gating refinement. Tagging @deploybot-team.

deploybot: [NOTIFY] Pin exemption added for model-group:quant-pipelines by @Priya. Pin remains in place pending manual unpin.

Taylor: Will cut SDK 2.8.2 patch in next 2 hours and run canary on staging quant longseq.

Maria: Great. If all goes well we'll unpin runtime this afternoon during the 17:00-18:00 UTC change window. If not, we'll extend pin and escalate. :thumbsup: 

Priya: ack

Jamal: ack
